canonical_name: Incredible Business Networking (IBN) Biz Lunch - Woodfin NC
summary: IBN is a free, sponsor-funded business networking lunch run by Incredible Towns of WNC, held the 4th Thursday monthly at The Village Porch in Woodfin, led by two local business people (Diane Simmons of eXp Realty and Gabi Juba of Juba Forensics). The organization explicitly markets itself as having no membership, no dues, and no attendance requirements, inviting anyone to drop in any time and swap business cards for referrals; only the meeting leaders recur by design, not a fixed attendee roster.

evidence.note: Listings are thin, generic marketing copy ('Join us for Networking and great Pub food in Woodfin!') with no mention of members or regulars, organizer shown only as 'Incredible Towns of WNC'.
Event page states 'Free To Attend, No Dues Or Fees', 'No Membership Required', 'No Attendance Requirements', 'All Inclusive'; names two rotating meeting leaders but no member roster.

Parent IBN program page describes itself as 'WNC's largest free and independent business networking group' explicitly built on drop-in access ('attend our FREE Events Any Time') rather than a committed membership base, and encourages bringing 'a big stack of business cards' for transactional referral swapping.
Third-party listing corroborates the same free/no-membership framing and meeting leader (Diane Simmons).
